name: brawer-homepage-nav-tests
description: Playwright tests for the site's hand-written interactive JS (assets/js/nav.js) — the mobile drawer, the fullscreen art viewer, and safe-area padding. See CLAUDE.md's 'Browser/interaction tests' section for what's covered and how/when to run this.
